title: One take, two cameras
pitch: Shoot once, film it again with the camera moving, cut between them on one sound track.
why: Reshoot keeps the action and the timing, so the two takes cut together at the same timecode, like two cameras on one set.

fields.label: The action
fields.default: A street food cook tosses noodles over a roaring flame at night, steam drifting through neon light

tips: One clear action reads best from a second angle.
Reshoot takes about 8 minutes per angle here.

steps.label: Cut between
